## Value
- [h2] For anyone who has watered too much, or too little.
- [p] Fernlight tells you which plant needs water today, based on its window and the season, and stays quiet the rest of the time.
- [h3] Set by your window and the season
- [p] Your schedule comes from the plant, the window it sits by and the season. When spring turns to summer, Fernlight adjusts it for you.
- [h3] One tap, then quiet
- [p] Fernlight reminds you on the day a plant needs water. Check the soil, water the plant, then tap once to log the watering. That is all until the next one.
- [h3] A care card for every plant
- [p] Monstera, east window, 1 m away: water every 9 days in spring, next on Thursday. Bright, indirect light. Feed once a month from April to September. Your care plan puts every care card in one place.

## How it works
- [h2] Your window and the season set the schedule.
- [p] You answer two questions. Fernlight works out the watering day.
- [h3] Add a plant
- [p] Take a photo of the plant or search for it by name. Fernlight knows about 600 common houseplants.
- [h3] Describe its spot
- [p] Say which way the window faces and how far the plant sits from it.
- [h3] Fernlight sets the schedule
- [p] You don't enter the season. Fernlight knows it. Plant, window and season together set the schedule. As the seasons change, the schedule changes with them.
- [h3] Water on watering day
- [p] You hear from Fernlight on the day a plant needs water. Log the watering with one tap and it goes quiet until the next one.

## FAQ
- [h2] Questions, answered plainly.
- [h3] Will it nag me?
- [p] No. You hear from Fernlight on the day a plant needs water. Log the watering with one tap and it goes quiet until the next one.
- [h3] How does it know when to water?
- [p] Fernlight starts with the plant. Then it looks at the window: which way the window faces and how far the plant sits from it. You don't enter the season. Fernlight knows it. Plant, window and season together set the schedule. As the seasons change, the schedule changes with them.
- [h3] Will it tell me exactly when to water?
- [p] It suggests a day, not an order. Always check the soil first. Fernlight tells you this too.
- [h3] Which plants can I add?
- [p] About 600 common houseplants. Take a photo of the plant or search for it by name.
- [h3] What is in the sample care plan?
- [p] A care plan puts all your plants' care cards and watering days in one place. A care card is one plant's page: how often to water it, the light it likes and when to feed it. The sample shows one plant: a Monstera by an east window.
- [h3] What does it cost?
- [p] Free covers up to 5 plants. Fernlight Plus is $3 a month for unlimited plants, plus photo check: send a photo of a leaf that looks wrong. Free and Fernlight Plus both let you add a plant by photo. There are no ads.
